metadata.description: A networked PARA knowledge brain for coding agents — documents managed by PARA and woven into one connected graph, held in a searchable Postgres store with a revision history per document and reached through its remote MCP server.

plugins.name: engram
plugins.description: Networked PARA knowledge brain. Manages documents by PARA (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives) and weaves them into one connected knowledge graph through bi-directional links, MOC hubs and integrity checks. The brain is a shared Postgres-backed store reached only through the remote `engram` MCP server (engram serve) — searched rather than grepped, with a revision history per document and aliases that keep links alive across moves. Carries the capture-loop hooks that keep the brain fed; they run the `engram` binary, which /mcp__engram__setup installs
